description: This file defines the MaterialsProviderInterface interface within the Awsypto namespace. It specifies the required methods for classes that implement cryptographic material providers, including key size support, envelope processing, cipher suite information, and key/IV generation.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterface
classes.description: Interface for cryptographic material providers, defining the essential methods for key size support, envelope processing, algorithm retrieval, and key/IV generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if the given key size (in bits) is supported by AES.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Initializes the provider based on the data inside the MetadataEnvelope.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrap algorithm used by this provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using the provider.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a random content encryption key of specified size.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector for encryption using the specified OpenSSL cipher name.
